source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    TABLE_NAME AS TableName
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo'
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
    'SELECT TableName, LastWatermarkValue
     FROM water.WatermarkControl
     WHERE TableName = ''',
    item().TableName,
    ''''
)

text.value:
@concat(
    'UPDATE water.WatermarkControl
     SET
        LastWatermarkValue = (
            SELECT MAX([',
    if(
        equals(item().TableName, 'Products'),
        'created_at',
        if(
            equals(item().TableName, 'Customers'),
            'created_at',
            'order_date'
        )
    ),
    '])
            FROM dbo.[',
    item().TableName,
    ']
        ),
        source_count = ',
    string(activity('Copy data1').output.rowsRead),
    ',
        dst_count = ',
    string(activity('Copy data1').output.rowsCopied),
    ',
        total_count = ',
    string(activity('Copy data1').output.rowsCopied),
    '
     WHERE TableName = ''',
    item().TableName,
    ''';'
)
